params.body:
`AppAdmitOnKeyTest::test_a_period_for_proposals_names_what_portal_would_name` fails on every run since 2026-10-08 11:00 UTC, on main and on every pull request (portal #384 among them).

The test froze Laravel's clock at 2026-10-08 09:00 and expected "until Thu 08/10 13:00". The token it signs expires two hours after that frozen moment, but `OperatorKeys` checks the expiry against `time()`, which `Carbon::setTestNow` does not freeze. Once the wall clock passed 11:00 UTC that day, the admission was refused and `said` came back null.

Both tests that froze that date now freeze the real current minute and compute the expected sentence from it. The 30-day reading test had the same flaw and would have started failing on 2026-11-07.

`php artisan test --filter=AppAdmitOnKeyTest`: 5 passed, twice. Pint clean.
params.title: AppAdmitOnKeyTest: freeze the real minute, not a fixed date
